objective: Style the five auth pages and FormField's Field in the narrow form-card template of wiki/CodeContext/FrontendUI/layout.md section 3, using the shared components.
acceptance_criteria: Each of SignInPage, SignUpPage, ConfirmPage, ForgotPasswordPage and ProfileSetupPage renders its form inside a Card (asserted through Card's module class).
Every request failure on those pages renders through InlineAlert with unchanged text and role="alert".
ConfirmPage's resend notice renders through StatusLine with unchanged text and role="status".
Every submit button renders through Button with variant primary; Resend code uses variant secondary.
Field still renders label, then control, then hint, then error, with the same ids; its error message has an aria-hidden icon and unchanged text.

Every *.module.css file this unit adds contains no hex, rgb(), hsl() or named colour, no px font size, and no outline: none or outline: 0 without a :focus-visible rule in the same file (a static test reads the files from disk).
src/auth/accessibility.test.tsx, src/auth/no-secret-leak.test.tsx and every page test pass unchanged.
Every existing test in the suite passes unchanged; no existing test file is edited.
